statements.impact_statement: An UNMAINTAINED-crate advisory, not a vulnerability: the author archived the repository and RustSec records no flaw and no patched version. `paste` is a procedural macro that pastes tokens at compile time, reached only through five crates of the Leptos 0.8 family the operator console builds on (`cargo tree -i paste@1.0.15`), and only from the `ferropix-console` member, from `ferropix-testkit`, which takes the console as a dev-dependency for its browser journeys and is never published, and so in the graph from `ferropix-server`, whose tests take the testkit. Neither `ihe-iti` nor `nl-generic-functions` depends on it in any feature, so it is absent from the crates this document describes. Re-evaluate when the console's image is released, and on the next Leptos release.
